package http

import (
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4/middleware"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/config"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	privatehttp "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http/private"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/usecase"
)

type Router struct {
	cfg            *config.Config
	apiRouter      *v1.Router
	sessionSummary *usecase.LearningSessionSummaryService
}

func NewRouter(cfg *config.Config, apiRouter *v1.Router, sessionSummary *usecase.LearningSessionSummaryService) *Router {
	return &Router{cfg: cfg, apiRouter: apiRouter, sessionSummary: sessionSummary}
}

func (r *Router) Setup(e *echo.Echo) {
	e.HideBanner = true
	e.Use(middleware.Recover())
	e.Use(middleware.RequestID())
	e.Use(middleware.Logger())

	internalGroup := e.Group("/internal")
	privatehttp.NewRouter(r.cfg.InternalToken, r.sessionSummary).Register(internalGroup)

	apiGroup := e.Group(r.cfg.HTTPBasePath)
	r.apiRouter.Register(e, apiGroup)
}
